title: Customer
description: Customer functionalities and workflows in Rozgar Connect

features.name: Searching Workers
features.description: Customers can search for skilled workers by applying combinations of category, city, and area filters. Results are sorted based on preference (newest, highest rated, most reviewed).

features.name: Viewing Worker Profiles
features.description: Customers can click on worker profiles to see details: photo, description, verification badge, phone, WhatsApp number, average rating score, total review count, and a list of customer reviews/comments.

features.name: Internal Chat
features.description: Allows direct messaging between the customer and worker in real-time. Customers can click 'Chat Now' on a worker's profile to open a chat interface, send messages, and see when the worker is typing or online.

features.name: Ratings & Reviews
features.description: Customers who hire workers can review them. They choose a rating from 1 to 5 stars and write a comments text. A customer is limited to exactly one review per worker profile.

features.name: Switching to Worker Role
features.description: If a customer wishes to offer their own services, they can upgrade their profile. This triggers a role addition request that appends 'worker' to their database user roles.

switching_role_flow.action: Click 'Become a Worker' in the user profile navigation dropdown.
switching_role_flow.headers: Requires Bearer Access Token in Authorization header
switching_role_flow.database_actions: Appends 'worker' to the user's Mongoose 'roles' array, saving the updated document.
switching_role_flow.session_update: Generates a new access token containing the updated roles claims and returns it to the client.
switching_role_flow.frontend_handling: The frontend receives the new access token, updates the Redux store (loginSuccess / updateUser), and redirects the user to the Worker Profile Setup page ('/worker-setup') to define their services.

notes: Customers cannot access worker dashboard routes or admin routes unless they possess those specific roles.
